test_name: Identification and Authentication - IA-3 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Reporting-Service-067
Primary NIST family: Identification and Authentication (IA); evidence focus: IA-3.
Environment: Azure Government. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: external support identities are federated, individually attributable, time-bounded, and strongly authenticated. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
